reasoning: The completed matched study changed pooling while retaining identical 97-wide frozen contextual64 plus ordered-byte33 features and 3,169 trainable gate parameters. Every trained checkpoint failed the frozen eligibility floors; both selected actual cold step zero.

Global removed one negative emission while losing two previously exact positives. Local step120 gained two/lost one exact positive but removed two/introduced three negative emissions; local240 gained two/lost two and removed two/introduced two negative emissions. Aggregate equality can conceal case substitutions.

TRAIN local BCE improved .426070 to .349219 and negative emissions112 to99/512 while positive whole exact declined322 to317/512. This supports testing an objective that explicitly penalizes positive margin loss, but proves neither an encoder-capacity bottleneck nor that a new byte branch will help.

The donor already encodes byte order. Keeping representation, architecture, pairing, schedule and optimizer identical across arms isolates the retention objective before introducing representation trainability.
